newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU parliament demands release of Wang Dan.
newsitem.headline: EU parliament demands release of Wang Dan.

text.p: The European Parliament on Thursday demanded the liberation of Chinese dissident Wang Dan and urged that his appeal against imprisonment get a fair hearing.
The Beijing Higher People's Court is due to hear the appeal against the dissident's 11-year sentence for plotting to overthrow the government on Friday .
The parliament said it "deplores the sentence...and calls for him to be released immediately."
It urged "all politicial and judicial harassment of him to be brought to an end" and called for all judicial and procedural guarantees to be applied at the appeal.
The Beijing court was widely expected to reject the 27-year-old dissident's appeal and uphold his conviction, Chinese lawyers said. In China, appellate courts rarely overturn rulings by lower courts.
The parliament also urged the EU and its members to instruct local representatives to monitor the progress of the appeal.

Wang's appeal comes four days before the scheduled arrival of the U.S. Secretary of State, who diplomats say was expected to raise human rights issues in his meetings with Chinese leaders during his November 19-21 visit.
Beijing has slammed Western criticism of its human rights record as interference in its internal affairs.
